reviewStandard: All six routes fail the pre-generation exact-analyte, clinical-route, polymer/receptor, organism-specific sensing, therapeutic-product, or drug-reaction gate. They receive no marked prompt, generation call, or raster.
promotionRule: No Batch 087 route is eligible for generation or promotion until its documented identity, clinical route, structure, organism, modality, reaction, measurement, and evidence conflicts are corrected and independently re-audited.

routeDecisions.reason: Unconjugated p-cresol, host conjugates, compartments, assays, CKD retention, and ASD/PD hypotheses are conflated with causal claims.
routeDecisions.requiredResolution: Define exact analyte/identifier, precursor and microbial pathway, host conjugation, compartment, assay/units, population/renal state, outcome, and evidence tier.

routeDecisions.reason: Formulations, aluminum and trace elements, enteral deprivation, microbiota, populations, and outcomes are merged; the page includes an invalid linear developmental extrapolation and unsupported IV-iron gut mechanism.
routeDecisions.requiredResolution: Split by component and population; define formulation, route, dose, duration, age/organ function, comparator, microbiota or clinical outcome, and certainty.

routeDecisions.reason: The sparse route omits polymer structure and variation and oversimplifies TLR2, NOD1/NOD2, PGRP, wall-context, and disease recognition.
routeDecisions.requiredResolution: Select organism/chemotype; define repeat and cross-link, wall context/modification, released fragment, receptor and compartment, assay, cell, and immune outcome.

routeDecisions.reason: Bacterial signal systems, acid-resistance enzymes, fungal Rim101, urease, gut gradients, fermentation, and metal speciation are merged and contain an internal chemistry contradiction.
routeDecisions.requiredResolution: Split by organism and named sensor; define compartment, pH range/stimulus, downstream response, growth condition, metal species if relevant, measurement, and phenotype.

routeDecisions.reason: Whole phages, cocktails, enzymes, virome associations, and engineered vectors are conflated with universal efficacy, biofilm, resistance, and microbiome claims.
routeDecisions.requiredResolution: Split by modality and exact product; define phage/genome, strain/receptor/host range, formulation/route/dose, model, comparator, endpoint, resistance/safety, and evidence tier.

routeDecisions.reason: Many drugs, reactions, organisms, effect directions, clinical stages, and speculative metal links are merged; pyridoxal phosphate is incorrectly labeled metal-dependent.
routeDecisions.requiredResolution: Create drug–enzyme–organism records with substrate/product, compartment, assay, exposure, pharmacokinetic endpoint, replication/covariates, and intervention evidence.
